title: PoP created
description: An operator created a PoP relay (R74, docs/76). The event names the PoP and nothing else about it: never an address, the pairing string or a credential. The `data` of a `fi.ioio.gawk.pop.created` CloudEvent.

pop.description: The PoP the operator acted on: the Pop resource's name.

displayName.description: The PoP's name as shown to people.
